title: Calculation Steps
text: First calculate the ratio: sin(theta_c) = 1.00/1.52 = 0.6579. Then use the inverse sine function: theta_c = arcsin(0.6579).

title: Practical Application
text: theta_c = arcsin(0.6579) = 41.1 degrees. This means any light hitting the glass-air boundary at an angle greater than 41.1 degrees will be totally internally reflected. This is the principle behind fiber optic cables and sparkling diamonds.
